collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: As fish spoil in the heat, a cook wonders whether distant people have a box that keeps food cold as a deep cave.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: As fish spoil in the heat, (name1), a cook, wonders whether distant people might have a box made of metal that keeps food as cold as a deep cave.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The cook imagines never losing fish to the heat again.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A builder wonders how anything could stay cold without ice, and decides it must be very clever.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders what such a box would need to keep working.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A farmer worries that people who rely on it might forget how to dry and salt food.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The pit floods in the next rain, and the cook goes back to the drying racks.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The village digs a cool pit in the shade, and fish last a little longer.
